_comment: Credential ROUTING DECISION on a vault miss: (credential.kind, public_config.subscription_only, whether the vault holds a direct entry) -> which category the relay resolves to. Categories are language-neutral: credential (a key to fetch with), skip (benign, carrying the server-recognised wire marker), missing (a key was expected and is absent -> the App Server records the card failed). The human `detail` sentence is deliberately NOT pinned — each relay names itself in it. Reference: resolveEntryCredential in frontend/src/lib/refresh/credential.ts. Ports: _resolve_credential (CLI orchestrator.py), RefreshOrchestrator.resolveCredential (macOS). Two kinds are deliberately absent: oauth_mint needs a live mint, and oauth_installation_grant is the ONE kind the three legitimately differ on (only the browser can serve it) — pinning either here would assert an agreement that does not exist. AUTHORED input, GENERATED expect - run `make gen-vectors` after changing the reference.

vectors.name: a direct vault entry wins before the kind is even considered
vault_key marked subscription_only skips as a keyless card
vault_key with no marker is a missing key, not a skip
an absent credential object defaults to vault_key (unmarked -> missing)
an absent credential object defaults to vault_key (marked -> keyless skip)
an unrecognised kind skips as unsupported, it does not fail the card
an unrecognised kind skips the same way when the card IS marked keyless
